phrases.text: This tiny spoon could weigh a billion tons.
Somewhere in space, a star died.
Its core collapsed into something so dense...
Imagine squeezing the mass of an entire mountain|into something smaller than a city.
A teaspoon of its material would weigh|around a billion tons on Earth.
That's not even the craziest part.
Some neutron stars spin|hundreds of times every second.
And some shoot beams of radiation through space|like a cosmic lighthouse.
So next time you think space is just|a bunch of pretty stars,
Somewhere out there, there's a star so dense|that a teaspoon of it weighs more than a mountain.
